To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

the use of the voice and the face together in person perception is more effective than the use of either modality alone, that this is the case for both positive and negative traits, that this is true for the perception of personality and physical appearance, and that this is true when the voice and face are either congruent or incongruent.
the face is a dominant cue for the perception of personality and the voice plays only a minor role.
In summary, our research is concerned with
how the human face is perceived and how the perception of the face is related to the perception of speech.
how we perceive the social world.
the role of face and voice information in person perception and the interaction between them.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the use of a single voice in the context of a single voice is not a significant issue.
there is a strong relationship between the face and voice in terms of person perception.
there are no significant differences between the face and the voice in terms of person perception.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we are interested in the perception of social information, and the way in which this is integrated with information from other sensory modalities, and with prior knowledge.
we are interested in the perception of faces and voices, and how they interact.

we have shown that face and voice information can be integrated into a single person representation, and that this integration occurs at the level of the person, rather than at the level of individual facial features or vocal characteristics.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the human brain has a remarkable ability to integrate information from the face and the voice in order to perceive a person, even if the two signals come from two different individuals.
we can use the face and voice together in order to improve our ability to identify people.
people are not only influenced by the face of a person they meet, but also by their voice, and the two interact.
